arguments.value: This agreement is between ALPS Distributors, Inc. and S2K Financial LLC. ALPS Distributors, Inc. is the distributor for several NorthStar real estate funds listed in Exhibit A, and S2K Financial LLC is hired to market and introduce those funds to broker-dealers and other financial intermediaries. S2K must use reasonable efforts to promote the funds, follow securities laws and industry rules, and may help with seminars, literature, and other marketing activities, subject to ALPS review and approval. ALPS coordinates selling agreements, reviews and files marketing materials, and may facilitate payment of dealer reallowance fees to S2K under the funds’ prospectuses and Exhibit B. The agreement includes mutual representations, confidentiality obligations, indemnification provisions, and limits on use of each party’s name. S2K is an independent contractor and cannot bind ALPS. The agreement can be terminated on 60 days’ notice or when the related distribution agreement ends. The source states that the agreement is governed exclusively by the laws of the State of Colorado, with exclusive jurisdiction in state or federal courts in Denver, Colorado.
